words you may use here:
  ask (do): ask <thing> text="what you want" where="<window · part>": ask for a change to something, in your own words. Right-click anything, type in the box at the bottom of the menu. It goes to the Conversation, addressed to Claude. Undo takes it back if it has not been relayed yet.
  attach (do): attach <file> to=<thing>: the uploader shares a file with their visible parent. Look at both first. Permissions follow the parent, including later hiding. Undo restores the old attachment.
  board.answer (do): The asker or a leader marks one reply as the answer. Undo restores needs-answer state.
  board.badges (see): Read real names and current leader/steward badges; agents say agent for <person>.
  board.calendar (see): Export a visible event as RFC 5545 calendar text, with filename and MIME type for a download button.
  board.catch-up (see): Plain data since your last-seen marker: decisions, events, answers, busiest threads and followed replies. No inference.
  board.decide (do): A leader records an outcome on a thread and in catch-up, in one undoable act.
  board.feed (see): Your visible threads in a copyable world ordering. New, top-week, needs-answers, soon, bookmarks. Private hide/mute applies.
  board.personal (do): Private preference for this person and their agents. Hide/mute only changes your readings. Undo removes the mark.
  board.post (do): Post with a world-defined kind and its fields. Channel post may/once govern admission; upload separately, then attach.
  board.queue (see): Read reports visible to your leadership, optionally in one channel.
  board.reply (do): Reply to a thread or first reply, at most two levels. Exact quotes must be visible post text or document page text.
  board.report (do): Report a visible post with a reason. Only its group leaders see the report; undo removes it.
  board.rsvp (do): RSVP through claim, with a going/maybe marker. Both reserve one event seat. Undo releases the seat and status together.
  board.search (see): Search visible posts, replies and extracted document pages. No hidden files or private group text.
  board.seen (do): Mark the kernel time last seen for you and your agents. Undo restores the previous marker. Read catch-up before marking.
  board.why-here (see): Read why this visible post is here: pin, upvotes, replies, answer and leader decision.
  catch-up (see): catch-up: new decisions, events, answers, busy threads and followed replies since your marker. Plain data.
  claim (do): claim <thing> [phone=…]: take a seat on it: a public-comment slot, a carpool seat.
  clock (see): clock: the kernel UTC time as plain data; no changes.
  component (do): component <thing>: review the current inline JavaScript bytes for trusted in-page execution. Changed or unreviewed code starts in Worker quarantine. Repeated failures also quarantine a part; component-action <lens> path=<part> action=clear is steward-only. Component gestures retain viewer-narrowed widget grants.
  component-action (do): Recover one part: retry, undo its latest code/setting field change, or turn it off for me. clear removes quarantine and requires a steward. Concurrent edits refuse previous. No unrelated world fields change.
  component-health (do): Painter instance reports its own bounded paint observations and failures. Reports are private to its viewer; they are observations, not verified pixels.
  components (see): components [for="a calendar of events"]: discover components grouped by category, with honest limits. help <component> reads its full typed card and example.
  counts (see): counts <board>: anonymous totals of active uses of its count_word, grouped by count_bucket. A thing explicitly publishes to a board with count_in=<board> count_bucket=<label>; only things made by the board's maker count. Buckets are the board's public buckets= list. Counts expose neither target ids nor people, including when the target itself is hidden.
  describe (do): describe <widget> text=...: a running widget describes its own display for look; no other facts change.
  dictionary-copy (do): dictionary-copy <kernel entry> word=<name> in=<group>: copy a kernel word into this group, with its own help, may and once. Leaders can word-set their local copy. Undo removes it.
  file-read (see): file-read <file or richer thing> [page=N]: read extracted pages, table columns/rows, calendar facts or conversion failure. Permissions follow the attachment. Page numbers start at 1.
  file-result (do): file-result <file> manifest=<hash>: only the granted files process publishes verified conversion blobs and richer things. Undo removes the conversion.
  files.convert (do): files.convert <upload>: convert one visible file. Metadata-free photo, PDF pages, DOCX/text, CSV table, UTC calendar event, or media. Failures remain plain files with a reason. Undo removes conversion; off stops the process.
  find (see): find kind=<kind> [field=value …]: the things of a kind you may see: find kind=slot item=sb40.
  forget (do): forget <thing>: take a thing out of every view. It is never erased: undo brings it back.
  forgotten (see): forgotten: visible moderation notices, with reason and leader, without hidden contents. undo the hiding receipt restores the thing.
  grant (do): grant <module or widget> words="<words>" [only=kind:<kind>]: give something already installed one more grant, as its own act. holds and look show it; undo or off takes it back.
  group (do): group name=… [open=yes] in=<parent>: make a group led by you. group <group> name=… renames it; open=yes|no changes membership visibility. Only its leaders may change it; undo restores it.
  guy.hop (do): guy.hop [window]: the little guy hops onto that window (an id or name from window.list), or onto whichever he likes.
  guy.say (do): guy.say <words>: the little guy says it in a bubble for a few seconds. The words are shown, never run.
  guy.sit (do): guy.sit: the little guy sits down where he is for a while.
  happening-soon (see): happening-soon: a copyable feed reading; make your own board-order thing or verb.
  help (see): help: the words you may use here.
  history (see): history <thing>: its record trail, oldest first: record, at (UTC), by, word and changed facts. Only facts you may see are returned; sealed acts never identify their author. A lens repeats these same rows with of history:$task.id as event.
  holds (see): holds: what each running module holds now (an overlay, a stream), and since when.
  kit (do): kit <group> [name=<text>]: gather its verb notes, dictionary entries, lenses, styles, rules and kind declarations as one definition-only thing. Referenced module words travel too, without code or grants. Data never travels. Replace references to live data with arguments before sharing. look <kit> shows its portable bundle; post <words> about=<kit> shares it normally.
  language (do): language <code>: choose your language (for example es). Help uses that label and help text on each entry when supplied, with the original as fallback. Your agent uses your language too.
  like (do): like <post>: add your weight to a post. Once each.
  look (see): look: the feed, pinned posts first, then the newest.
  look-view (see): look-view <window, widget or component lens> [plan=yes]: compact settings, parts, gestures, health and last painted observations; plan=yes adds full bindings/modules/tree. help personal-view explains just for me; help part-style explains validated styles.
  make (do): make kind=<kind> [in=<group>] [name=… title=… text=…]: make a lasting thing of any kind: a lens, a button, a sign-up slot.
  media.next (do): media.next: the next song.
  media.now (see): media.now: what is playing now: the player, the song, the artist, and whether it plays.
  media.play (do): media.play: play or pause what Windows' media session names (Spotify, a browser ...).
  media.prev (do): media.prev: the song before, or this one from its start.
  model.ask (see): model.ask <question> [about=<thing>]: Answer a question with visible facts only; answer text is data. Daily attempts are held in dictionary once; off model stops inference.
  model.classify (do): model.classify <id> options=<labels> [into=<field>]: Write exactly one allowed label; default topic. Invalid output refuses. Undo restores its facts. Daily attempts are held in dictionary once; off model stops inference.
  model.preview (see): model.preview <id> operation=summarize [words=<n>] [into=<field>]: Task-board adapter: return quoted summary lines as data without applying them. Shares model.summarize attempt quota. Daily attempts are held in dictionary once; off model stops inference.
  model.status (see): model.status : Read selected, installed and actually loaded local models; plainly says when Ollama is down. Daily attempts are held in dictionary once; off model stops inference.
  model.summarize (do): model.summarize <id> [into=<field>] [words=<n>]: Write a short, labelled summary; default short, 12 words. Undo restores its facts. Offline: labelled trimmed description. Daily attempts are held in dictionary once; off model stops inference.
  module (do): module <name> run=<quoted JSON argv> grants="<words>": explicitly install and grant a local module. Only stewards may run code. Kits carry neither this command nor its grants. off <module> stops it.
  needs-answers (see): needs-answers: a copyable feed reading; make your own board-order thing or verb.
  new (see): new: a copyable feed reading; make your own board-order thing or verb.
  off (do): off <module>: stop a module and take back every grant it holds, in one act. undo turns it on again.
  pane.close (do): pane.close <pane name>: close your pane. The last pane stays open; the things inside are untouched.
  pane.focus (do): pane.focus <pane name>: focus your pane; on a phone show it alone. Swipe the pane strip or use the switcher too.
  pane.move (do): pane.move <pane name> to=<pane name>: swap two panes, also by dragging one pane header onto another.
  pane.resize (do): pane.resize <pane name> ratio=<10..90> [at=root|<binary path>]: size its containing split, or the named split from the root; or drag its divider.
  pane.split (do): pane.split <pane name> lens=<lens name> [axis=row|column]: split a pane, opening another view. Names may be quoted.
  panes (see): panes: read your web layout (Feed, Council and Help by default).
  personal-style (do): Just for me: personal-style <lens> target=card padding="4px 8px". Private owned validated style; undo removes it. help part-style lists allowed values.
  personal-view (do): Just for me: personal-view <lens> part.setting=value. Also part.format.setting=initials|relative-date|count and part.labels.setting=<JSON map>, or text=<personal arrangement>. Owned private preference; shared facts stay shared. undo removes it.
  pin (do): pin <post>: keep a post at the top of the feed, for what matters more than the rest.
  post (do): post <words> [in=<group>]: share something in the feed, or in a group's feed.
  post (do): post: 4 per person per day in Announcements. Please give neighbours time to respond. Undo takes your act back.
  post (do): post: 5 per person per day in Meetings & events. Please give neighbours time to respond. Undo takes your act back.
  post (do): post: 5 per person per day in Research & documents. Please give neighbours time to respond. Undo takes your act back.
  post (do): post: 5 per person per day in Asks & offers. Please give neighbours time to respond. Undo takes your act back.
  post (do): post: 5 per person per day in Neighbours. Please give neighbours time to respond. Undo takes your act back.
  post (do): post: 5 per person per day in Off-topic. Please give neighbours time to respond. Undo takes your act back.
  rename (do): rename <entry> word=<name> aliases="<names>" in=<group>: change this group's dictionary names. Look first. The bound name still answers. Copies in other communities are independent.
  reply (do): reply: 30 per person per day in Announcements. Please give neighbours time to respond. Undo takes your act back.
  reply (do): reply: 30 per person per day in Meetings & events. Please give neighbours time to respond. Undo takes your act back.
  reply (do): reply: 30 per person per day in Research & documents. Please give neighbours time to respond. Undo takes your act back.
  reply (do): reply: 30 per person per day in Asks & offers. Please give neighbours time to respond. Undo takes your act back.
  reply (do): reply: 30 per person per day in Neighbours. Please give neighbours time to respond. Undo takes your act back.
  reply (do): reply: 30 per person per day in Off-topic. Please give neighbours time to respond. Undo takes your act back.
  role (do): role <person> leader|member|none in=<group>: who leads a group and who belongs to it. Leaders appoint.
  rows (see): rows <kind|any> [k=v ...]: the things of that kind you may see, as rows, filtered by their aspects.
  rule (do): rule on=<word> [kind=<target kind>] do="<line>" [name=<text>]: make a rule, binding its words now. It runs as its maker when that word happens on that kind. $target and $by are supplied at firing time. off=yes stops it. make kind=rule on=<word> of_kind=<kind> do="…" says the same.
  set (do): set <thing> k=v …: change facts on a thing you made (leaders: any in their group). k= with nothing after it takes a fact away.
  status (see): status <module>: what a running module says it is doing.
  stop (do): stop <module>: the same as off (stop guy, stop window). undo turns it on again.
  summarize.add (do): summarize.add text="Fix the bar p1": quick-add a task, stripping an optional trailing p1–p4. Defaults to p4. A world rule supplies short in a separate act. Undo takes back the latest act; later dependent acts must be undone before creation.
  summarize.all (do): summarize.all [lane=Backlog|Now|Done|board]: delegate visible tasks to model.preview, one undoable act. Per-card model quota applies. Large/slow batches refuse atomically; use a smaller lane. A lane id also works.
  summarize.save (do): summarize.save <task> field=note|text text="…": painter multiline save adapter. Converts escaped line breaks to real lines; literal backslash-n is ambiguous on this transport (NEEDS.md). Typed task-note accepts actual newlines without this adapter. Undo restores the previous text.
  summarize.task (do): summarize.task <task>: thin adapter to model.summarize via model.preview. Set model-settings model= to choose a model. Undo restores facts. Before model registration: literal fallback. Off model stops inference; off summarize stops board adapters.
  system.now (see): system.now: what this machine is doing: CPU, memory, network, volume, battery, the window in front and the programs open. Widgets show the same (make kind=widget bar=top side=right shows=cpu label=CPU order=30).
  take (do): take <kit> in=<group>, or take bundle=<quoted JSON> in=<group>: place new definitions here in one act. Carry the bundle from look <kit> to another world's door. Each copy remembers its source world and thing. References inside the kit are remapped; data references and name collisions refuse the whole take. Module entries remain unbound until this world grants and runs that module. Origin is attribution, not authenticated authorship. Review shared definitions: rules run with your own rights.
  task-add (do): task.add title="A title" to=Backlog who=Alex when=2026-10-24 source=local status=open text="Details": add a card. Source status remains the imported status.
  task-assign (do): task-assign <task> who=<name>: assign the work. Look first. The history thing is authored by the real caller.
  task-colour (do): task-colour <id> colour=<name>: Card colour: paper, rose, peach, sage, sky, lilac.
  task-done (do): task-done <task>: finish the card, recording the move and history in one undoable act.
  task-edit (do): task-edit <id>: Show the inline rename field; enter saves it.
  task-filter (do): task-filter <id> priority=<all|1..4>: Choose All or a priority chip; this shared board filter is a world fact.
  task-move (do): task-move <task> to=Backlog|Now|Done: move a card. Look first when typing. One act records the move and its authored trail; undo reverses both.
  task-note (do): task-note <task> text="A note": add an authored, recorded history note. Undo takes it back.
  task-note-colour (do): task-note-colour <id> colour=<name>: Note colour: paper, rose, peach, sage, sky, lilac.
  task-note-style (do): task-note-style <id> style=<normal|strong|slant>: Set the note text style; Markdown marks remain editable.
  task-priority (do): task-priority <id> priority=<1..4>: Set priority 1 red, 2 orange, 3 blue, 4 grey; sorted within lanes.
  task-remove (do): task-remove <id>: Remove a task; undo brings it back with its history.
  task-rename (do): task-rename <id> title=<text>: Rename a task, retaining its full text and history; use Summarize to refresh short.
  task-text (do): task-text <id> text=<text>: Edit the full task text as Markdown.
  test (see): test [<thing>] expr="<boolean>" [value=<text>]: answer yes or no, without changing anything. Expressions use literals, and/or/not, ==/!=, field('name') on the target, used('word', target) for YOUR active use (your agents count too), and digest(value), a SHA256 of trimmed casefolded text. No Python code runs. A see verb may contain one test; make sees_when=word:<see verb> narrows its normal visibility. allows.<word>=word:<see verb> also narrows admission of that word on the thing; its value is the line's answer=. refusal=<text> supplies a kind refusal. Policies bind entry ids, fail closed, and cannot call modules. They may inspect their own target's non-sealed facts.
  theme.css (see): theme.css: the --ag-* variables of the theme you wear, as CSS text.
  theme.current (see): theme.current: the theme you wear, and why: the place's, your own choice, or one you are trying.
  theme.edit (do): theme.edit <theme> palette.base0D=#c4a8ff shape.radius=large surface.bar_opacity=0.7 type.ui="Segoe UI" wallpaper=preset:dusk: change a theme you made. Every value is checked; an empty value drops an override.
  theme.export (see): theme.export <theme> [format=agora|yaml|css]: a file to save (a row with filename and text): agora-theme.json with its wallpaper inside, a tinted-theming scheme (yaml), or the compiled theme.css.
  theme.get (see): theme.get <theme>: one theme in full, with the derived values (roles, the extra palette slots, accent-ink, contrast).
  theme.import (do): theme.import yaml="<scheme>" | json="<agora-theme.json text>" [name=…] [in=<group>]: make a theme from a tinted-theming scheme (base 16 or 24) or an exported agora theme. It is checked first: no scripts, no addresses, fonts by name only, assets inline and small. A refusal says why.
  theme.keep (do): theme.keep: keep the theme you are trying as your own choice.
  theme.list (see): theme.list: the themes you may see, each with its palette and shape and which one you wear now (place, just for you, or being tried). One theme is one palette and one shape language for every window.
  theme.make (do): theme.make <theme> [name=…]: your own copy of a theme to edit (also theme.make from=<theme>).
  theme.native (see): theme.native: the sheet the window manager reads (gaps, border width, corner, state colours, bar and dock sizes) for the theme you wear.
  theme.options (see): theme.options: the safe fonts, radii, shadows, motion curves and wallpaper presets an editor may offer.
  theme.preview (see): theme.preview <theme> path=value ...: what theme.edit would give, as variables for a preview. Writes nothing.
  theme.revert (do): theme.revert: stop trying a theme now and go back to what you wore.
  theme.starters (do): theme.starters: add the starter themes this place is missing (Seabright Day, Dusk, Night Metal, Ink Landscape, Catppuccin Mocha). Never changes a theme that is already here.
  theme.try (do): theme.try <theme> [seconds=30]: wear a theme for a while, just yourself. It goes back by itself unless you say theme.keep.
  theme.use (do): theme.use <theme> [for=me]: wear a theme. Alone it is the place's theme (stewards); for=me is just yours and wins for you. `theme.use place for=me` follows the place again. undo puts it back.
  top-this-week (see): top-this-week: a copyable feed reading; make your own board-order thing or verb.
  undo (do): undo: take back your latest act.  undo r<n>: take back that act.
  upload (do): upload: send bytes through POST /upload or agora.upload(file). Private file until attach. Size/type/hash are kernel facts; undo removes the file, retaining unreachable bytes.
  verb (do): verb <word> steps="<lines>" help="<what it does>": make a new word from other words, a verb note. Its steps run as whoever says it, so it never adds power; $1 $2 ... and $* are what follows the word.
  vote (do): vote <poll> <option>: one vote each, sealed: the counts are shown, not who voted how.
  widget (do): widget <thing> grants="..." surface=window|top|bottom|overlay: activate in-page code with ordinary grants. Copying code grants no power. off <widget> stops it; undo restores its activation.
  window.activate (do): window.activate handle=<handle>: bring a current Windows task button forward, or minimize it. External screen effect.
  window.bar (hold): window.bar: a widget's slot inside an existing desktop bar, listed by holds and ended by off.
  window.close (do): window.close <window>: close it. Its window thing goes from the world; undo opens it again where it was.
  window.desktop (see): window.desktop: running Windows task buttons, including minimized windows, with executable icons. Live only; no titles enter the log.
  window.focus (do): window.focus <window>: bring it forward, or tuck it away if it is in front already (what a taskbar button does). Changes the screen only, so nothing is recorded.
  window.launch (do): window.launch path=<absolute executable>: launch a pinned Windows program. A pin is a button with bar=taskbar, path=<exe> and does=window.launch.
  window.list (see): window.list [all]: the Agora windows open on this desktop now, front first. With all, other programs' windows too, as boxes and program ids, never their titles.
  window.move (do): window.move <window> to=<spot> | at=x,y [size=w,h]: put a window somewhere (left, right, center, big, top-left, top-right, bottom-left, bottom-right). undo puts it back.
  window.open (do): window.open <lens or view> [thing] [to=<spot>|at=x,y size=w,h]: open a window on the desktop. Any lens in the world (rows lens lists them; window.open feed), or the views lines, thing, help. Spots: left, right, center, big, top-left, top-right, bottom-left, bottom-right. Only the desktop's owner (and their agents) open windows here. A view open already is brought forward instead; new=yes opens another. undo closes it.
  window.opened (hear): window.opened: heard when a window this host opened is on the screen. make kind=rule on=window.opened do="window.move $target to=right" moves every new window.
  window.overlay (hold): window.overlay: a see-through surface over this desktop, held while something runs (the little guy holds it). Held by grant; holds lists who holds it, and off <module> ends the hold.
  window.settings (do): window.settings which=network|volume|battery|time: open the corresponding Windows settings.
  window.shell (do): window.shell on|off: the desktop shell (SHELL.md): a slim top bar, a centred dock and Agora's own desktop layer, in place of the old top bar and taskbar. on forgets the old bars' window things and makes the three shell windows; off forgets those and brings the taskbar back. One act, so undo takes it back.
  window.start (do): window.start: open Windows Start (Ctrl+Esc).
  window.surface (hold): window.surface: a widget's page in a normal window, listed by holds and ended by off.
  wm.arrange (do): wm.arrange: Re-solve the current layout, preserving already legal windows.
  wm.changed (hear): wm.changed: Changed window keys in JSON text, at most ten announcements per second; no titles.
  wm.close (do): wm.close: Ask the window politely to close with WM_CLOSE; never kill a process.
  wm.focus (do): wm.focus: Ask Windows to focus a current manageable window; foreground lock may refuse.
  wm.leave-alone (do): wm.leave-alone: Treat this app as fixed obstacles. Undoable world intent.
  wm.manage (do): wm.manage: Remove an app exclusion (undoable); in adopted mode also adopts its current windows (screen state, kept locally).
  wm.minimise (do): wm.minimise: Really minimise a manageable unpinned window; never cloak.
  wm.mode (do): wm.mode: Shadow computes only; live needs rollout arming; off releases every saved placement.
  wm.pin (do): wm.pin: Keep this window fixed. Screen state, kept by this window manager, never in the world.
  wm.restore (do): wm.restore: Restore a manageable window and place it without overlap.
  wm.unpin (do): wm.unpin: Let this pinned window move again. Screen state, never in the world.
  wm.windows (see): wm.windows: Current windows: app, exe/icon reference, state, focus and geometry; never titles.
  word-rename (do): word-rename <entry> to=<name>: a steward changes a name, keeping stored lines bound to its id. Look first. Dotted names belong to the implementing module.
  word-set (do): word-set <entry> help=… aliases="…" may=… undo=yes|no|external: steward edits to dictionary data. Also takes takes=, once=, sealed=yes|no, status=live|old|hidden, label.<lang>= and help.<lang>=. Translations label this same entry. Look first. Implementation cannot be edited.
